text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahahahaha! Trainer! Have you polished 
the chalices?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it obvious?! To celebrate my 
victory, and receive the supreme nectar 
poured by the Goddess herself!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh...! My legs are tingling! My 
heart is boiling over! Today, I am truly 
the god of war galloping across the blue 
heavens!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Kuhahahaha!! Feast your eyes as the world 
becomes drunk on me...!
